dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
I was robbed! Bastard!
{WHAT WAS STOLEN?}What was stolen?
My axe! I've been working for so long to get it!
{HOW DID IT HAPPEN?} Sir, were you assaulted? Was this a burglary?
No, just a shameless theft! The deal was - I drop the axe and he drops gold, but that bastard just picked the axe, didn't pay and ran away instead!
{I DON'T UNDERSTAND}Sorry, I don't really understand.
Hey, it's simple..
{WHERE?} Where did it happen?
In the Evergreen Forest. Near the blacksmith's house.
{ADDRESS?} I'm asking for your real address.
It's [[ADDRESS]].
It's 243 1st street.
It's 4576 Wide Avenue.
It's 9th street.
{GOLD?} So, he was supposed to pay with... gold?
Yes, it's the currency here. We've agreed for 6000 golden coins.
{WHAT?} I'm confused. I don't get it.
{IS IT A GAME?} Sir, are we talking about a computer game?
It's in the game! That's how the trades go, but he tricked me and stole my axe!
{WHO DID IT?}Do you know who did it?
His nickname is NiceOrk1337. He belongs to the Misty Assassins' Guild.
{NOT AN EMERGENCY} Sir. Events happening in virtual worlds... they are not emergencies.
But it was a robbery!
{I CAN'T HELP YOU} Tell me, honestly, would it help if I sent the police over?
Um... not really.
{CAN'T DO ANYTHING}So there's nothing I can do for you, Sir.
Uhhh.... Gosh. Alright, I will find him and kill him myself.
{YOU'RE RIDICULOUS} Come down to earth, man. 911 is intended to be used in real emergencies.
It was a real robbery! Okay, I'll get him on my own!
Are you there?
{I'LL SEND THE POLICE} Alright, I'll send the police to you.
You better hurry!

reportElement.texten: The operator has lost his temper.
The caller reported a robbery in a virtual world.
The policeman reported that the intervention was completely unnecessary.
